segments.sn46.27:1.1: “Yo, bhikkhave, maggo yā paṭipadā taṇhānirodhāya saṃvattati, taṃ maggaṃ taṃ paṭipadaṃ bhāvetha.
segments.sn46.27:1.2: Katamo ca, bhikkhave, maggo katamā ca paṭipadā taṇhānirodhāya saṃvattati?
segments.sn46.27:1.7: Kathaṃ bhāvitā, ca bhikkhave, satta bojjhaṅgā kathaṃ bahulīkatā taṇhānirodhāya saṃvattanti?
segments.sn46.27:2.1: “Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ…pe…
segments.sn46.27:2.2: upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
segments.sn46.27:2.3: Evaṃ bhāvitā kho, bhikkhave, satta bojjhaṅgā evaṃ bahulīkatā taṇhānirodhāya saṃvattantī”ti.

lines: Chaṭṭhe etadavocāti “imissaṃ parisati nisinno udāyitthero nāma anusandhikusalo bhikkhu atthi, so maṃ pucchissatīti bhagavatā osāpitadesanaṃ ñatvā desanānusandhiṃ ghaṭessāmī”ti pucchanto etaṃ avoca.
Subhāvito hi satisambojjhaṅgo vipulo ca mahaggato ca appamāṇo ca abyāpajjo ca nāma hoti.
So hi patthaṭattā vipulo, mahantabhāvaṃ gatattā mahaggato, vaḍḍhipamāṇattā appamāṇo, nīvaraṇānaṃ dūrībhāvena byāpādarahitattā abyāpajjho nāma hoti.
Taṇhāya pahānā kammaṃ pahīyatīti yaṃ taṇhāmūlakaṃ kammaṃ uppajjeyya, taṃ taṇhāpahānena pahīyati.
Kammassa pahānā dukkhanti yampi kammamūlakaṃ vaṭṭadukkhaṃ uppajjeyya, taṃ kammapahānena pahīyati.
Taṇhakkhayādayo taṇhādīnaṃyeva khayā, atthato panetehi nibbānaṃ kathitanti veditabbaṃ.
Nīvaraṇavigame sambhavato paccayato byāpādo vigato hotīti āha –
Yañhi taṇhāsahagataṃ asahagatampi taṇhaṃ upanissāya nipphannaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ taṇhāmūlakaṃ.
